meta.name: redis
meta.description: Read and write Redis cache/store data using redis-cli or Upstash REST API. Manage keys, lists, hashes, sets, and sorted sets.

copy.tagline: 查看并修改缓存数据,管理集合、列表、哈希等类型。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要经常查看或清理网站缓存数据。
copy.tagline_en: View and edit cached data, and manage lists, hashes, and other types.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to inspect or clear cached data.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 redis-cli 或 Upstash REST API 连接 Redis,执行读写键值、设置过期、管理哈希/列表/集合/有序集合等操作,并处理连接失败、认证错误等异常。
howto.when: 当用户要求读写 Redis 数据、管理键或列表/哈希等数据结构时触发;需先配置 REDIS_URL 或 Upstash 的 REST 地址与令牌。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect to Redis via redis-cli or Upstash REST API, perform GET/SET, set expiry, manage hashes/lists/sets/sorted sets, and handle errors like connection failures or auth issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read/write Redis data, manage keys, or work with data structures like lists or hashes; requires REDIS_URL or Upstash REST URL/token configured.
